messages.models.each_card_is_a_voice: Each card is a voice model. Press Install on a model the app can install itself, and Test to check that an installed model speaks on this computer: the test loads it and speaks one short sentence. Models the app cannot install yet are listed under More models, with what each one needs.
messages.models.each_card_s_facts_come: Each card's facts come from the Lab's records: its catalog, its adapters, the installers and the language screen (docs/LANGUAGE_MATRIX.md); where they say nothing, the card says "not stated". A card's Details say whether it is integrated and what the language screen heard. Integrated means the adapter is in this build. Installed means its environment and pinned checkpoint are on disk. Usable means a short test passed on this device. An integrated model does not mean every upstream feature has been exposed or tested. The RAM on a card is the free memory the Lab wants before it loads that model.

messages.models.time_per_second_of_speech: Time per second of speech is the seconds it took to make one second of audio, the median of the clips, so below 1 is faster than real time. Rows come from the clips and tests this computer ran on each device. Precision is not measured; this table records speed only.
